output: Use your image generation tool exactly once. Reply with one short sentence.
rules: Use no text, letters, digits, labels, logos or watermarks. Centre one subject in about 80 percent of a square canvas with even padding and no cropped edges.
transparent: Background: fully transparent (a real alpha channel). No ground shadow plate, backdrop or scenery.
plain: Background: one plain flat colour, no scenery or gradient.

reference.task:
Create one picture that will serve as the style reference for a whole series of mind-map pictures.
Subject: {{subject}}.
It must show the medium, line quality, palette and level of detail of the series.
reference.example: For example, a lamp or cup can demonstrate the style with one recognisable silhouette.

node.task: Create one picture for the mind-map node {{node}}.
node.path: Context (path from the top of the map): {{path}}.
node.subject: Choose one concrete subject that carries the meaning of the node. For an abstract idea, use one concrete stand-in object or a simple visual metaphor.
node.example: For example, a watering can pouring onto a seedling could stand for nurturing. Choose a subject specific to this node.
node.silhouette: Use a clear silhouette with a memorable detail. Keep it simple.
node.siblings: Its siblings are {{siblings}}. Give this picture a distinct object type, silhouette and dominant colour.
node.match: A style reference image is attached. Match its medium, line quality, palette and level of detail, drawing a different subject.
